# sherpa-button

The primary interactive trigger. Two templates, selected by data-type: default (icon(s) + label), icon (square).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Built on | the native `<button>`, which gives click, keyboard, focus, disabled |
| Templates | `default`, `icon` |
| Figma | Button |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-button/sherpa-button.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-button/sherpa-button.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-button/sherpa-button.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-button/sherpa-button.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-button/sherpa-button.example.json) |

## When to use it

For an action on this page: save, add, delete, open a dialog with `commandfor`, or open a `sherpa-menu` in its `menu` slot. To go to another page, write a real `<a href>`, not a button.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-button>Save</sherpa-button>
<sherpa-button data-look="saturated" data-icon-start="plus">Add customer</sherpa-button>
<sherpa-button data-type="icon" data-icon-start="cross" aria-label="Close"></sherpa-button>
<sherpa-button disabled>Delete</sherpa-button>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | text |  | native: what it is told — `--show`, `--hide` |
| `commandfor` | text |  | native: the id of the element a press commands (a dialog, a panel) |
| `data-badge` | text |  | the text of the trailing [sherpa-badge](sherpa-badge.md) (or slot a node into "badge") |
| `data-icon-end` | text |  | icon glyph value |
| `data-icon-start` | text |  | icon glyph value |
| `data-label` | text |  | label text (or use the default slot) |
| `data-look` | `saturated` `transparent` |  | saturated (primary) \| transparent (tertiary) (omitted = default / "secondary": white surface, grey border, dark ink) |
| `data-no-tab` | boolean |  | out of the tab order — for a host whose own keys do the same (a stepper) |
| `data-no-tip` | boolean |  | no tooltip — for a host that composes the button and says it itself |
| `data-open` | boolean |  | set by JS while its slotted menu is open — CSS only |
| `data-size` | `2xs` `xs` `sm` `lg` `xl` |  | 2xs \| xs \| sm \| lg \| xl (default omitted = base size) |
| `data-status` | `critical` `warning` `success` `info` `urgent` |  | critical \| warning \| success \| info \| urgent (tints the look tier) |
| `data-tip` | text |  | the tooltip's text. Unset: an unlabelled button's tip is its aria-label, and a labelled one has none |
| `data-type` | `icon` |  | icon |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native disabled state |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | text, icon | label content |
| `badge` | badge | trailing badge |
| `menu` | menu | a [sherpa-menu](sherpa-menu.md) this button opens |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`tip`, `trigger`

## populate()

`{ badge?, iconEnd?, iconStart?, label?, noTab?, noTip?, open?, size?, tip?, type? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
